source_authority: Preserve frozen EDF-002 import evidence unchanged; verify a reviewed, bounded launcher supersession against both historical and active Git blobs.

records.review: The original official CLI launcher is preserved at its EDF-002 accepted Git blob. This exact EDF-005 blob adds one optional root-scoped mutex for mutating official CLI commands on identity-initialized factories, shared with the typed control API. It does not alter legacy uninitialized roots, read-only CLI commands or the accepted lifecycle/storage implementation. All original source authentication and current-byte checks remain required; no provenance is backdated. The official cold portability command now holds the same root lock and refuses pending detached requests or accepted ambiguous receipts, preventing a false portable-safe claim during root-owned operations.
records.limitations: Direct imports of the historical module bypass the official launcher coordination; the typed manager still checks current factory revision and instance generation before mutation.
